decisions.reason: This data-centre connectivity service remains close to the firm's strategic core in cloud and high-bandwidth infrastructure, and despite limited later visibility its option value is still positive because it can be folded into broader enterprise connectivity offerings at relatively low incremental cost.

By 2022 the uncertainty around this voice-related ordering portal should be largely resolved, and if it has not become a meaningful digital channel by now its standalone value is too limited relative to better software-defined growth options.

A direct voice connection service is less aligned with the firm's forward path toward integrated cloud and data infrastructure, and after several years without stronger evidence of traction management would reallocate resources to higher-upside network and platform products.
